snippet.description:
Sam Witwer breaks down the challenge of bringing Darth Maul to life in Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord, revealing how deeply personal—and intense—the performance really is.

In this exclusive Collider interview, Witwer explains what it means to play Maul as both protagonist and villain, and why the character demands bold, risky choices. He reflects on honoring the legacy of Ray Park and Peter Serafinowicz while evolving Maul into something new for longtime fans and newcomers alike. Witwer also dives into the surprising physicality of voice acting, describing how he pushes himself emotionally in the booth to capture Maul’s instability and rage.

Beyond performance, Witwer shares insight into the creative process behind the series, including collaboration with director Brad Rau and guidance from Dave Filoni. He also teases how Shadow Lord is designed as both a standalone entry point into Star Wars and a deeper character study, gradually bringing audiences inside Maul’s psyche.

For fans curious about the future of Maul—or the craft behind animated Star Wars storytelling—this conversation offers a revealing look behind the scenes.
